# Captured Generals Expanded - all scripted localisation merged into one file (original file order kept).

# ===== cge_exchange_localisation.txt =====
defined_text = {
    name = CGEGetExchangeAvailability
    text = { trigger = { has_variable = cge_selected_general var:cge_selected_general = { has_character_flag = cge_exchange_cooldown } } localization_key = CGE_EXCHANGE_COOLDOWN_TT }
    text = { trigger = { has_country_flag = cge_exchange_active } localization_key = CGE_EXCHANGE_ACTIVE_TT }
    text = { trigger = { NOT = { cge_exchange_selected_is_prisoner = yes } } localization_key = CGE_EXCHANGE_PRISONER_REQUIRED_TT }
    text = { trigger = { NOT = { has_any_general_captured_by = var:cge_exchange_ui_partner } } localization_key = CGE_EXCHANGE_NO_HOSTAGE_TT }
    text = { localization_key = CGE_EXCHANGE_READY_TT }
}

defined_text = {
    name = CGEGetExchangeNavigation
    text = { trigger = { has_country_flag = cge_exchange_has_more } localization_key = CGE_EXCHANGE_NEXT }
    text = { localization_key = CGE_EXCHANGE_FIRST }
}
